items.title: Who is Ilse Aigner, leading candidate for Germany's next president?
items.desc: She would be the first female president and the first Christian Social Union politician to hold Germany's highest office. Ilse Aigner is the favored candidate for the Federal Convention vote on January 30.

items.title: Warbaahinta Carabta oo toosh ku ifisay caqabadaha horyaalla dowladda dhiska Israa'il iyo ninka loo igmaday
items.desc: Iyadoo dadaallada lagu dhisayo dowlad cusub oo Israa’iil ah ay socdaan, doorka xisbiyada Carabta ayaa noqday mid muhiim ah. Haddaba, ogow sida warbaahinta Carabtu u aragto caqabadaha horyaalla Eisenkot.

items.title: Somali Olympic boxer Ali weeps as world title dream realised
items.desc: Ramla Ali dedicated her win to her late father as she defeated Mikiah Kreps to become the unified super-bantamweight world champion.
